about: What each route of a box answers (scripts/route-shapes.sh writes it from Packages/Box/src/shared/routes; never edit it): its JSON by status, or "bytes". A shape is "string", "number", "bool", "null", "any", {list}, {map}, {object} (those fields and no others; a name ending in ? may be left out), {oneOf} or {literal}. A refusal (400 and over) in JSON is `error`, unless its route has a shape of its own for that status; what starts with a `passedOn` path is the engine's or the agents bridge's own.
